# Steering wheel — Savino (CC0)

Author: Savino. Original publication: 19 January 2013.
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/steering-wheel
Original download: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/low_6.obj
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public-domain dedication), as listed by the author.
License text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

`savino-wheel.obj` is the original download. `savino-wheel.glb` is a local format conversion of those vertices/faces, triangulated and scaled to a 0.38 m width, with computed normals and a dark material. No replacement steering-wheel geometry was generated. Used only as the NSX's game cockpit accessory; it is not claimed to be a manufacturer-authentic NSX part.
